name: savytox
description: Local-first token-saving terminal output and context optimization for VS Code LLM workflows.

savytox.engine.description: Token-saving engine. The default extension mode works without external software.

savytox.optimizationMode.description: Controls how much command output is compacted.

savytox.enableTokenSaverTerminal.description: Enable the SavytoX Token Saver Terminal command.

savytox.enableShellIntegrationCapture.description: Allow SavytoX to use VS Code shell integration when available. It does not modify shell profiles.

savytox.externalCommand.description: Optional external CLI command used only when savytox.engine is external-cli or auto.

savytox.showStatusBar.description: Show SavytoX token savings in the VS Code status bar.

savytox.maxOutputChars.description: Maximum optimized output size for built-in filters.

savytox.preserveErrors.description: Preserve errors, warnings, failed tests, and stack traces while compacting noisy output.

rtk.command.description: Legacy optional external RTK command. Prefer savytox.externalCommand for new setups.

rtk.apiBaseUrl.description: Backend API base URL used for Microsoft login and secure RTK usage sync.

rtk.authRequired.description: Require Microsoft login before organization usage sync and protected RTK dashboard data are available.

rtk.refreshIntervalMs.description: How often the status bar refreshes token savings.

rtk.defaultAgentCommand.description: Default command for RTK: Start Agent Terminal.

rtk.showTotalWhenNoSession.description: Show lifetime total savings when the active session has no recorded runs.

rtk.syncEnabled.description: Send anonymized RTK usage snapshots and events to the configured backend API after login.

rtk.syncIntervalMs.description: Minimum interval for backend usage sync attempts.

rtk.autoWrapTerminals.description: Automatically install shell hooks so supported commands run through RTK-Node in VS Code and Codex shells. Enable this to opt in, and remove hooks with RTK: Disable Automatic Terminal Wrapping.

rtk.followWorkspacePath.description: Keep the displayed RTK session aligned with the current workspace folder path.
